text: The almond croissants here are absolute perfection. Crisp on the outside, flaky and buttery. Staff is always smiling even during the morning rush!
Best balayage in the city! Maria listened carefully to what I wanted and gave great advice on hair care. The salon is spotless and welcoming.
Honest mechanics are hard to find, but Apex diagnosed my brake issue in 15 minutes, showed me the worn pads, and charged exactly what was estimated.
The flat white was delicious, but seating is very limited and it was too loud to read a book. Would grab takeout again though.
Pasta was tasty and well-seasoned, but our main course arrived 45 minutes after the appetizers. Waiter was polite about the kitchen delay.
Dr. Miller is gentle and thorough with cleanings. Only downside is the billing department took three weeks to process my insurance paperwork.
Brought my commuter bike in for a simple gear tune-up. Got it back two days late, the chain started slipping immediately on my ride home, and the tech was defensive.
Ordered two large pizzas for a family birthday party. The driver delivered them completely cold and crushed on one side. When I called the store, the supervisor hung up on me.
We had an appointment at 2 PM for our cat's annual shots and sat in the waiting room for over an hour without any explanation or update from reception.
Technician arrived promptly within the scheduled window and fixed the leaking kitchen pipe quickly. Left the cabinet clean and dry. A bit pricey, but solid work.
